# Activation Plan Functions

Builds the runtime contracts for the mounted Activation Clause. The planner gives each configured required role its own reviewed source selector and guard. Selectors name a published event type, clause and subject. Contracts matching includes subtypes. Distinct source and subject combinations prevent overlapping role selectors. The planner rejects duplicate selectors, validates source and basis pointers and validates a distinct declared acceptance role when supplied.

The installed workflow contributes to Activation only through the matching source event. The private channels and per-role guards prevent the direct role operations from bypassing a configured review. Roles without a reviewed source keep the ordinary Activation planning path.
